display_name: NIST fit-for-purpose + COCO metrics + corruption robustness demo gate
decision_note: Metrics are grounded in NIST fit-for-purpose TEVV guidance and common object detection / corruption-robustness benchmarks. Numeric thresholds remain program-level acceptance criteria and should be tailored to the deployment context.
source_grounding: NIST AI RMF / Playbook: fit-for-purpose TEVV, deployment-context evaluation, monitoring, acceptable limits
COCO-style object detection metrics: precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95
Corruption robustness literature: mean performance under corruption (mPC) and relative performance under corruption (rPC)

gates.description: Clean reference performance must remain operationally credible on COCO-style AP50.
Performance under adverse/critical scenarios must remain above a minimum functional floor.
Relative performance under corruption should remain at or above 65% of clean-reference AP50.
No mission-critical scenario may fall below the critical failure floor.
